seoDescription: Start the conversation with Reid Design LLC. Free 20-minute discovery call. Responses within one business day.
heroSubhead: Fill out the form and I'll be in touch within one business day. No commitment, just a conversation about what your space could become.
formIntroNote: [NEW per audit] If you can, mention which room or rooms, your rough timeline, and what's not working in the space. The more honest you are, the better the first conversation goes.

children.text: When you submit this form, it goes directly to me, not to an automated sequence. I read every message personally and respond with a note about next steps, usually within 24 hours on weekdays.
The discovery call is free, 20 minutes, and completely informal. We'll figure out together whether your project is a good fit for what I do.
